theme_and_archetype.vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, highly trustworthy. A premium industrial feel—like a pristine Porsche service center rather than a gritty local shop.
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The user requested keeping the current theme (Blue #0070ea and white/light theme with dark sections) while making it more premium. Archetype 4 allows us to use high-contrast stark whites and deep obsidians with the brand blue to create a sense of technical authority and absolute trust.

primary.name: RPM Blue
primary.usage: CTAs, critical brand accents, high-priority interactive elements.

rules: Use 'The Tinted Grey' rule: never pure #808080, always slate or zinc.
No full-screen muddy gradients. Use solid colors with sharp 1px borders.
Hero image overlay max opacity: bg-black/40.

heading_font.usage: All H1, H2, and major callouts. Never use generic sans.

body_font.usage: Body text, paragraphs, smaller UI elements.

marketing_services.description: Bento-style layout for services. Mix 3+ shapes (The Hero col-span-8 row-span-2, The Square col-span-4, The Filler col-span-4).

dashboard_lead_management.description: Dense, highly scannable layout for the lead management admin view. 1px borders, no soft shadows.

rules: Generous Spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. p-8 or p-12 in containers.
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding to prevent collision.

marketing_pages.style: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). 1px solid borders, no shadows.
marketing_pages.hero: Massive typography, bg-black/40 overlay on image. Never center everything—use aggressive asymmetry.

lead_management_dashboard.style: Neumorphism (Tactile) mixed with Grid Borders. Flat background, 1px subtle border, sharp inner contrasts.
lead_management_dashboard.tables: Dense, crisp lines. Use hover:bg-zinc-100/10 for rows.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0070EA] text-white font-bold hover:bg-blue-600 hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform

navigation.style: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) or solid white with a hard bottom border.

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: Lenis for smooth scrolling (MANDATORY for premium feel).
motion_and_interaction.microinteractions: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-white). Focus states must have higher contrast.
motion_and_interaction.animations: Framer Motion for entrance staggers on the Bento grid. Very subtle, no bouncing.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install @phosphor-icons/react, framer-motion, and lenis. Apply layout for .js and tailwind usage without overcomplicating TSX elements since codebase might have pure .js files.
execution_order: 1. Update global CSS and Tailwind config with new fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi) and colors.
2. Strip out all booking system components; replace with Call/Text CTAs.
3. Implement the bilingual EN/ES context or i18n structure.
4. Refactor Marketing Page (Hero, Trust, Services Bento Grid) applying strictly the HTML/Tailwind styling with generous spacing.
5. Build Lead Management Dashboard using shadcn/ui components (dense Control Room grid).
6. Build the Image/Logo Management Admin tab.
7. Verify all text changes (12mo warranty, 30 min diagnostic, 110 Stanford Ave, no ASE).
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure every CTA button and form input has a data-testid. Verify responsiveness (images max-h-[80vh] on mobile).
